articles.title: Mapping Africa’s energy wealth and 560 million who remain without power - Al Jazeera
articles.description: Africa is rich in energy, yet hundreds of millions Africans still live without electricity, most of the world’s total.
articles.content:
Africa holds billions of barrels of oil, trillions of cubic metres of gas and produces most of the worlds cobalt and manganese for electric car batteries.
